cd /app/docs; cat election.md records.md counting.md output.md changelog.md

cd /app; ls data/cvr | head -30; ls data/cvr | wc -l; cat data/cvr/manifest.txt | head -5; head -c 1500 data/election.json; cat tests/test_tally.py | head -50; for f in $(ls data/cvr/* | head -4); do echo == $f; head -8 $f; done

cd /app/tests/fixtures; for d in write_ins basic; do cat $d/input/cvr/*.csv | head -30; done; head -c 600 batches/input/cvr/a.csv; cat /app/tools/check_tally.py | head -60; cd /app/data/cvr; head -12 scan_1125_18.csv; grep -L '^{' *.jsonl | head; file * | awk -F: '{print $2}' | sort | uniq -c

cd /app; head -70 tools/check_tally.py; ls data/cvr | sed 's/.*\.//' | sort | uniq -c
